checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: readout-only multi-item tour-order audit via exhaustive first-item ties

impact_assessment.why: The rule picks the lexicographically first shortest tour, but the probe does not show whether multiple first items achieve the same tour length. A readout-only audit can measure the current ordering choice without changing actions.
impact_assessment.benefits: probe.tour lists items/chosen/best_length/chosen_length/tied_firsts/tie_count/optimal on T1 movement steps; the eval counts tour steps, tie steps, extra tied firsts and optimal choices; rule_readout=False removes the field; actions/steps/rewards stay identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: readout-only probe.tour addition, no new policy key; dependency: stdlib itertools already imported; concurrency: none; state: telemetry probe grows by one dict on T1 moves.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse the existing exhaustive tour semantics; compute the audit only for T1 movement (not collect); test single/tie/no-tie/three-item/off/T3-no-tour/collect/action parity/JSON; run the seed battery and 361 tests plus AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: optional verdict ref cross-linking claims to logged episode evidence

impact_assessment.why: Claims and verdicts carry only free-text evidence; a verdict cannot cite the exact run/episode that supports or refutes it. An optional ref on Verdict can carry the episode digest from run_task_logged without changing claim status semantics.
impact_assessment.benefits: record(..., ref=...) stores a non-empty ref; to_dict/from_dict and claims_store preserve it; legacy verdicts load ref=None; a T3:15 claim cites the header episode_sha256; the eval shows run/two-runs/legacy/bad-ref.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: optional Verdict field plus record/from_dict handling, no claim-store schema bump; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: optional field in local claim snapshots.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default ref=None and validate non-empty strings; keep old payloads loading; test roundtrip/history/legacy/invalid/store/logged-run; verify the ref equals the header episode digest; rerun 369 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: read-only claim-ref verifier against live log episode headers

impact_assessment.why: Cycle 85 made verdict refs caller-provided but nothing checks them against a real log. A verifier can extract header episode_sha256 values and report verified/unverified/unreferenced refs, closing the provenance gap without changing claims.
impact_assessment.benefits: verify_claim_refs builds verified/unverified/unreferenced counts and unknown-episode findings; verify_claim_store loads a snapshot first; multiple logs and multiple headers per log are unioned; a real T3:15/T3:65 ref pair verifies 2/2 while a missing log or fabricated ref is named.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new claims_verify.py only, no claim/store schema change; dependency: telemetry.log read-only; concurrency: none; state: no writes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Require a ClaimLedger and at least one readable log with an episode header; validate missing/malformed/no-header logs; test verified/unknown/missing-log/no-header/multiple-headers/store/invalid; rerun 379 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: chain/HMAC integrity checks for claim-ref verification

impact_assessment.why: The cycle-86 verifier trusts any parseable header episode digest; a caller-supplied log with a copied digest passes. verify_chain can reject edited/reordered/unchained logs, and an optional hmac_key can verify keyed records, before their episode headers are trusted.
impact_assessment.benefits: verify_claim_refs(..., hmac_key=None, verify_logs=True) runs chain verification on every log; a tampered log raises by default while verify_logs=False keeps the membership-only ablation; a keyed log verifies with the correct key and fails with a wrong key; claim-store verification passes the same options.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: verifier kwargs only, claim/store schema unchanged; dependency: telemetry.log verify_chain; concurrency: none; state: read-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default to chain verification, validate hmac_key/verify_logs, name the failing findings, test intact/tampered/off/keyed/wrong-key/store/malformed, and rerun 389 tests plus AIKit.
